extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the in-scope issue by checking whether the selected result's exposure denominator is the retained subset while the claim covers the complete domain. The selected-result line (results/report.md L0015) divides by 96 scheduled stations, the denominator line (L0014) states the 24 omitted stations remain in the denominator, and workflow/analysis.py L0023 interpolates SCHEDULED_STATIONS rather than SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS; no 18/72 rate appears in any artifact. I also checked whether the row data contradict the 96/72/24/18 counts by scanning screen_status and occurrence_flag values across inputs/data.csv L0002-L0097, and they are consistent. The narrow retained-subset-denominator mismatch therefore could not be demonstrated.

unresolved_material_questions: Whether the missing-at-random status of the 24 screen-omitted stations makes the complete-domain rate a valid point estimate rather than only a lower bound is a separate estimand question, outside the single in-scope issue class.
